吃完早饭，一起出门上班，今天出门就碰见了何雨柱一行人，王野主动和对门的人打了声招呼，何雨柱也迎了上来，和王野并排走着。边走还边说着闲话，主要是何雨柱说，王野也有一句没一句的应和着。

聊着天时间过得也快，没一会儿就到了工厂。所有人都去了自己的工作岗位，这时赵爷爷叫住王野：“小野，刚才那个叫贾东旭的看你的眼神不对，你当心点儿！”

“贾东旭？我和他没什么交集呀！”

“当心点儿就行了，看着就不是个人物，没什么本事，当心点阴招就行了。”

王野认真的说：“赵爷爷放心吧！我会留意的，这小子真要是敢动歪心思，我也不会心软的。”

“臭小子！我不怕你被打，我怕的是你下手太狠，就你小子现在的功力要是下死手，就他那个小身板儿一招不死也重伤。”

“赵爷爷，我又不傻！现在是法制社会，哪能动不动就打死打重伤的，给他长长记性就得了。真要是那小子有太过火的举动，我把那小子带到我李叔那儿，吓都吓死他。”

赵爷爷笑骂道：“臭小子，就知道你不是省油的灯，人家还没动呢，你怎么治他都想好了。”

赵爷爷进了屋继续说：“去找你师父，让他给你安排个办公室，你还真一天天的守着我这老头呀？！”

王野笑着说：“赵爷爷，你这屋这么大，我就在这屋不就行啦！”

赵爷爷：“我稀罕你守着呀，滚蛋！”

王野边往外走边嘟囔着：“这老头，不识好人心。”

“臭小子，有本事你大点声！”

王野看见赵爷爷就要起身了，撒腿就跑。王野知道赵爷爷是想让他交自己的朋友，一天天总和一个老头在一起，迟早会磨完身上的朝气。

王野来到吴志强的办公室，现在趴着窗户看吴志强在不在。王野看见吴志强又在办公桌前打盹。

王野猛的打开房门，大声喊道：“吴叔，吃饭了！”

吴志强吓的一哆嗦，猛的坐直身子。看见是王野，站起来就要打他：“你个臭小子，吓死老子了！”

在办公室里一个追一个跑，也就是吴志强的办公室不小，要不根本就跑不开。眼看王野就要被抓住了，王野赶紧伸出双手阻止吴志强：“吴叔，赵爷爷有事儿交代。”

吴志强听到是师父的事儿，也就不和王野闹了，打了一下王野的头，就回到了办公桌前。

王野揉着脑袋说：“赵爷爷说，让你给我找个办公室，不用我一直在门房待着。”

“知道了，跟我来。”

吴志强带着王野来到门房边上的一间办公室，推门就进。屋里的人看见科长来了，全都站了起来。

吴志强对着一个岁数得有四十来岁的男人说：“老孙，以后王野就在你们办公室了。”

老孙拍着胸脯说道：“科长放心吧！指定安排的明明白白的！”

吴志强看向王野：“这屋里人岁数都不大，你们有的聊。”

王野笑：“好嘞！谢谢科长。”

吴志强：“你们熟悉熟悉吧，我先回去了。”

吴志强走后，老孙对着王野说：“我听科长叫你小野，我也这么叫了。”

王野：“孙叔好。”

老孙点点头继续说：“我是咱这个小队的队长，咱这个小队现在加上你一共6个人，咱这个小队比较特殊，一般都是守着大门。上下班盯着，主要是下班看看有没有夹带的。上班迟到的咱要登记。”

老孙喝了口水继续道：“其他时间还可以去厂里巡逻巡逻，这就看咱自己的心情了。因为有专门的巡逻队，咱也就随意了。一般我们也会出去转转，就当遛弯了。要不这坐一天也不得劲。”说完还“嘿嘿”笑了两声。

然后招呼所有人说：“王野咱们昨天都认识了，拿枪法绝了！你们也介绍一下自己。”

After breakfast, we went out to work together. When we went out today, we met He Yuzhu and his group. Wang Ye took the initiative to say hello to the people at the opposite door. He Yuzhu also came up and walked side by side with Wang Ye.They were chatting while walking, mainly He Yuzhu, and Wang Ye also echoed word by word.

Time passed quickly while chatting, and we arrived at the factory soon.Everyone went to their work stations. At this time, Grandpa Zhao stopped Wang Ye and said, "Xiao Ye, the man named Jia Dongxu just looked at you wrong. Be careful!"

"Jia Dongxu? I have nothing to do with him!"

"Just be careful. He doesn't look like a person and has no abilities. Just be careful of his dirty tricks."

Wang Ye said seriously: "Grandpa Zhao, don't worry! I will pay attention to it. If this kid really dares to have a wrong idea, I will not be soft-hearted."

"You brat! I'm not afraid of you getting beaten. What I'm afraid of is that you'll strike too hard. With your current skills, if you hit me with a deadly blow, you'll be seriously injured even if you're so small."

"Grandpa Zhao, I'm not stupid! This is a legal society. We can't kill or seriously injure anyone at every turn. Just give him a long memory. If that kid really does something too much, I will take that kid to my Uncle Li and scare him to death."

Grandpa Zhao laughed and scolded: "You brat, I know you are not a fuel-efficient lamp. He hasn't done anything yet, and you have already thought about how to treat him."

Grandpa Zhao entered the room and continued: "Go to your master and ask him to arrange an office for you. Are you really guarding this old man like me every day?!"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Grandpa Zhao, your room is so big, I can just stay here!"

Grandpa Zhao: "I don't care about you guarding me, get out of here!"

Wang Ye muttered as he walked out: "This old man doesn't know a good heart."

"You brat, if you can, speak louder!"

When Wang Ye saw Grandpa Zhao getting up, he ran away.Wang Ye knew that Grandpa Zhao wanted him to make friends with him. Being with an old man every day would wear off his energy sooner or later.

Wang Ye came to Wu Zhiqiang's office and was leaning against the window to see if Wu Zhiqiang was there.Wang Ye saw Wu Zhiqiang taking a nap at his desk again.

Wang Ye opened the door fiercely and shouted: "Uncle Wu, it's time to eat!"

Wu Zhiqiang shivered in fright and sat up straight.When he saw it was Wang Ye, he stood up and was about to hit him: "You brat, you scared me to death!"

One chased the other in the office, which meant that Wu Zhiqiang’s office was not small, or else he would not be able to escape at all.Seeing that Wang Ye was about to be caught, Wang Ye quickly stretched out his hands to stop Wu Zhiqiang: "Uncle Wu, Grandpa Zhao has something to explain."

When Wu Zhiqiang heard that it was about his master, he stopped arguing with Wang Ye, slapped Wang Ye on the head, and returned to his desk.

Wang Ye rubbed his head and said, "Grandpa Zhao asked you to find an office for me so that I don't need to stay in the concierge all the time."

"I know, come with me."

Wu Zhiqiang took Wang Ye to an office next to the concierge, opened the door and entered.Everyone in the room stood up when they saw the section chief coming.

Wu Zhiqiang said to a man in his forties: "Old Sun, Wang Ye will be in your office from now on."

Lao Sun patted his chest and said, "Don't worry, section chief! The designated arrangements are clear!"

Wu Zhiqiang looked at Wang Ye: "The people in this room are not old, so you can chat."

Wang Yexiao: "Okay! Thank you, section chief."

Wu Zhiqiang: "You should be familiar with it. I'll go back first."

After Wu Zhiqiang left, Lao Sun said to Wang Ye, "I heard the section chief call you Xiaoye, and I called you Xiaoye too."

Wang Ye: "Hello, Uncle Sun."

Lao Sun nodded and continued: "I am the captain of our team. There are currently 6 people in our team including you. Our team is quite special. We usually guard the door. We keep an eye on them when going to and from work, mainly to see if there are any entrapments after get off work. We have to register those who are late for work."

Lao Sun took a sip of water and continued: "We can go patrolling in the factory at other times. It depends on our mood. Because there is a special patrol team, we can do whatever we want. Usually we will go out for a walk, just like taking a walk. Otherwise, it will be boring to sit here all day." After saying this, he laughed twice.

Then he greeted everyone and said, "Wang Ye, we all met yesterday, and he is an amazing marksman! Please introduce yourselves too."
